", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“And the funniest thing about it, Mr. Regan, is that it is true. I pride myself that I am an artist. But the real and solemn truth is that the clue to Morgan’s buried loot is genuine. I have had access to records inaccessible to the public, which is neither here nor there, for the men of my own family—they are family records—have had similar access, and have wasted their lives before me in the futile search. Yet were they on the right clue—except that their wits made them miss the spot by twenty miles. It was there in the records.
